name: Coco Maria - Pérola Negra Club
description: DJ and broadcaster Coco María, originally from Mexico and based in Amsterdam, is a leading voice in the global Latin and tropical music scene. She is the host of the "Club Coco" show on NTS and founder of her own record label.
longDescription:
Coco María, a DJ and broadcaster from Mexico now living in Amsterdam, is known for her work in Latin and tropical music. She hosts the "Club Coco" show on NTS and has her own record label.

She plays at major festivals like Dekmantel, Glastonbury, and Worldwide. Her selections bring contemporary Latin rhythms to dancefloors.

The event takes place at Pérola Negra in Porto on Saturday, November 21, starting at 11:59 PM and running until 6:00 AM. Tickets are available for €10.00, offering priority entry until 2:00 AM.
